children: received another analyst endorsement as Citizens maintained a Market Outperform rating and a $550 price target, citing Chief Executive Satya Nadella's recent remarks on how artificial intelligence should be developed and deployed.

Nadella outlined four priorities during a Sept. 14 discussion: keeping people in control of AI, broadening access to the technology, giving businesses greater control over their data and maintaining rigorous safety checks.

Citizens analyst Patrick Walravens reiterated the firm's view in connection with those comments. The discussion comes as Microsoft continues shaping its approach to AI development across its software and cloud businesses.

Microsoft has also drafted a code of conduct for future AI systems. The framework emphasizes human oversight, external feedback and safeguards intended to keep people involved in decisions involving the technology.

Other analysts have issued separate updates on Microsoft in recent weeks. RBC Capital, for example, has maintained an Outperform rating and set a $640 price target, while focusing on Microsoft's cloud infrastructure operations and organizational changes.
The Citizens target stands at $550, offering another reference point for investors assessing Microsoft's AI strategy and broader business outlook.

title: Top Analyst Has Stark Message for Microsoft Stock Investors
